text: He spent ten dollars and sixty-nine cents… and stopped a cyberattack in over a hundred countries.
May 2017. WannaCry was locking computers everywhere. Hospitals. Factories. Trains.
Inside its code, a twenty-two-year-old found a strange web address nobody owned. So he bought it.
Before attacking, the worm checked that address. Now someone answered… and it switched itself off.
Three months later… the FBI arrested him.
The full story is on my channel.
